context: M19 o7. Lobby, evening. Folding chairs. Hollis's radio on the desk. Carmen arrives with food. Prentiss arrives with flowers.

lines.speaker: char.odessa_pruitt
lines.text: Forty years at sea, and he died in a hotel. He said he wouldn't. He was a liar.

lines.speaker: char.carmen_arce
lines.text: Mijo. I brought rice. And… Feld left. Last night. The machines are gone.

lines.speaker: char.mei_lin_chow
lines.text: Cutting table sold. He owes us severance. He sends a postcard. From Ponce.

lines.speaker: char.vic_prentiss
lines.text: Folks. Terrible thing. Terrible. The owners send their condolences. And flowers.

lines.speaker: char.odessa_pruitt
lines.text: Take your flowers outside, Mr. Prentiss. This room is full.

lines.speaker: char.teddy_arce
lines.text: Hollis's radio stays on the desk. Nobody turns it off.
